about: The music domain's port types (specs/eravos.compat-graph.spec › the model). The canvas compares names only; meaning lives here. 2026-11-13, CG1.

types.audio: sound, sample by sample (channels said by the port)
types.control: a control signal, sample or block rate (unit and range said by the port)
types.pitch: a frequency (unit Hz) or a note number (unit midi)
types.trigger: an instant: reset, retrigger, an event
types.note: note events: on / off with note number and velocity
types.data: a value or structure handed over in code (a layout, a voice assignment), not a signal

bridges.how: scale and offset into the pitch range (unit converted)
the note number, as Hz or midi
held while the note is on
